items.stem: User-supplied text is inserted with element.innerHTML and renders as markup. Which risk does this most directly create?

options.rationale: Correct: writing untrusted input to innerHTML lets injected markup and scripts execute in the page.
Rendering text to innerHTML is not a network performance issue.
The core risk is script injection, not merely layout.
SQL injection is a backend database concern, not this client-side sink.

items.stem: Which TWO practices reduce supply-chain risk from third-party frontend packages? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Commit a lockfile so installed versions are reproducible
options.rationale: Correct: a lockfile pins exact resolved versions and prevents silent drift.

options.text: Review a dependency's provenance and maintenance before adding it
options.rationale: Correct: vetting provenance and activity catches typosquats and abandoned packages.

options.text: Always install the newest version with no pin
options.rationale: Floating to the newest version invites unreviewed and possibly malicious updates.

options.text: Trust any package with many downloads without review
options.rationale: Popularity does not guarantee safety; compromised popular packages exist.

items.explanation: Correct: a lockfile pins exact resolved versions and prevents silent drift.

items.stem: A dependency audit flags many issues. What is the best first step before patching everything?

options.text: Triage by severity and whether the vulnerable code is reachable in your app
options.rationale: Correct: prioritising by severity and reachability focuses effort where real risk exists.

options.text: Delete every dependency that appears in the report
options.rationale: Blanket deletion breaks the app and ignores actual risk.

options.text: Ignore the report because audits are always noise
options.rationale: Dismissing audits wholesale leaves real vulnerabilities unaddressed.
Alphabetical order bears no relation to risk and wastes effort.

items.explanation: Correct: prioritising by severity and reachability focuses effort where real risk exists.
